name: Historic Town of Ouro Preto
description: Ouro Preto is a hillside colonial town in the mountains of Minas Gerais, Brazil, born in the gold rush of the late 1600s. Its steep cobbled streets climb past whitewashed houses, fountains and ornate Baroque churches, many carved by the sculptor Aleijadinho. By the 1750s it had around 80,000 people, far more than New York at the time.
